function SqlString($val) {
  if ($null -eq $val) { return 'NULL' }
  $s = [string]$val
  if ($s.Trim().Length -eq 0) { return 'NULL' }
  $s = $s.Replace("'", "''")
  return "'$s'"
}

function SqlNumber($val) {
  if ($null -eq $val) { return 'NULL' }
  $s = [string]$val
  if ($s.Trim().Length -eq 0) { return 'NULL' }
  $num = 0.0
  if ([double]::TryParse($s, [System.Globalization.NumberStyles]::Any, [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [ref]$num)) {
    return $num.ToString([System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  }
  if ([double]::TryParse($s, [System.Globalization.NumberStyles]::Any, [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::CurrentCulture, [ref]$num)) {
    return $num.ToString([System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  }
  return 'NULL'
}
